io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.guide

Class SurvivalSlimefunGuide

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.guide.SurvivalSlimefunGuide
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SlimefunGuideImplementation
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    CheatSheetSlimefunGuide

    public class SurvivalSlimefunGuide
extends java.lang.Object
implements SlimefunGuideImplementation
    The SurvivalSlimefunGuide is the standard version of our SlimefunGuide. It uses an Inventory to display SlimefunGuide contents.
    See Also:
    SlimefunGuide, SlimefunGuideImplementation, CheatSheetSlimefunGuide

      • createHeader

        @ParametersAreNonnullByDefault
public void createHeader(org.bukkit.entity.Player p,
                                                        PlayerProfile profile,
                                                        ChestMenu menu,
                                                        boolean footer)
        Draws the guide chrome into menu.
        Parameters:
        p - The viewing Player
        profile - That player's PlayerProfile
        menu - The menu to draw into
        footer - Whether to fill the bottom row. A ChestMenu sizes itself to its highest occupied slot, so a screen with only a handful of entries must skip it or be padded out to six rows of empty background.
